name: Hornero Agenda
description: Agenda 2.0: desktop widget of date facts from PluginKit Time: weekday, day, month, quarter, ISO week and week-year, day of year, days remaining and year progress. No events backend.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Time and Agenda 2.0: the 1.x date facts as labelled metrics plus quarter, ISO week-year, days remaining in the month and a year-progress bar, locale-correct dates and numbers, typed row settings with 1.x defaults and Argentine Spanish catalog. No events are shown: PluginKit has no calendar data source.
Desktop widget showing weekday, day and month, ISO week number, day of year and days remaining in the year, computed with pure Date math from PluginKit Time.

showIsoWeek.description: Show the ISO week and week-year row (the 1.x behaviour).

showYearProgress.description: Show the elapsed fraction of the year as a progress bar.
